name: anhedral
description: Scaffold application source and connect Anhedral projects, configuration, deployments and logs through the Platform.

interface.longDescription: Generate Next.js and Anhedral UI source, then add selected stack capabilities. Optionally connect your Anhedral account through OAuth to inspect projects, request secure variable imports, prepare staging deployments and request production approval. Secret values stay in the browser and Platform.
defaultPrompt: Initialize an application with the Anhedral stack, start it locally and open it in my browser.
